description.value: Rubble that would announce anyone else's approach just doesn't, under your feet. You don't take a circumstance penalty to Sneak across debris, broken glass, or loose scrap, and such terrain doesn't force you to reveal your position the way it normally would.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Sneak penalty removal and the no-reveal-position clause are both gated on 'debris, broken glass, or loose scrap', an environmental condition with no roll-option hook: pf2e's terrain roll options come from a closed environmentTypes enum (aquatic/arctic/desert/forest/mountain/plains/swamp/underground/urban; pf2e-source/src/module/scene/region-behavior/environment.ts:16-20, StringField choices restricted to that list) that has none of Cinderfall's wasteland terrain, and there is no GM-facing way to add to it. Real Rock Runner's own terrain:stone/terrain:earth predicate values aren't in that enum either, confirming this is a closed system, not a GM-extensible one.
